I found no bugs in the uncommitted changes. The only modified file is `rich/panel.py`, and I only read the diff and grepped the file. I didn't run the code or any tests.

The change adds a `partial_border_style` variable, which is the border style on its own without the panel's `style` merged in. The title and subtitle now call `stylize_before` with it at lines 204 and 253, instead of with the merged `border_style`.

- **Why it holds up:** The panel's own `style` is still applied to the title and subtitle when they are rendered, so they lose nothing. The merged `border_style` still colours the border segments.
- **What it fixes:** It stops the panel's background from being applied to the title text a second time on top of the text's own styling.
- **Compared with upstream Rich:** As far as I remember, upstream Rich does the same thing. I didn't check that against the source.
